title: Synthesis of Diverse Fields
intent: formative · Communication & Reflection (Applying) · click through the process
statement: Connect concepts from different fields to build a novel understanding or solution neither field reaches alone.

steps.title: Identify two domains
steps.text: Name the two distinct fields you are bringing together (Domain A and Domain B).

steps.title: Find the bridge variable
steps.text: Locate the common factor they share — optimisation, feedback, selection, scarcity.

steps.title: Map A onto B
steps.text: Carry the core concepts of one domain into the framework of the other through that bridge.

steps.title: Generate novel hypotheses
steps.text: Ask what the cross-over predicts that neither field alone would suggest.

steps.title: Test the fit
steps.text: Check where the analogy holds and where it breaks — the break is often the insight.

feedForward.text: Name two fields relevant to your topic and the one bridge variable between them, then one question the pairing raises.
